caption: Stanserhorn, Stans
composition: Stans looking south at the isolated cone of the Stanserhorn · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Stanserhorn rises as a single steep cone directly behind Stans, with the town roofs and the baroque parish church in the foreground. Meadows on the lower slopes are still green in late September. The mountain is an isolated horn in Nidwalden above Stans, not the jagged Pilatus massif, and no cable car is the subject. The Open-Meteo model is fully overcast, with soft light and no rain.
